behavior_before: The governed population owner could create packets and ingest candidate results, but had no operator-invoked real local inference worker, provider health command, structured response parser, or quality outcome classification.
behavior_after: The existing owner checks loopback Ollama, selects bounded authorized batches, sends packet-only prompts, parses and validates structured candidate output, classifies evidence quality, persists provenance without canonical mutation, and exposes review-required work.
dependencies_read: existing population scope and SQLite owner
existing provider health and model-control boundaries
changed_failure_modes: provider failures become retry/review outcomes rather than silent deterministic fallback
validation_evidence: live loopback Ollama health discovered nine models
two real troubleshooting work units completed as ACCEPTED_CANDIDATE
provider authority and malformed/invented-result boundaries tested
preliminary_troubleshooting_notes: A provider timeout or malformed response remains candidate/retry evidence; do not widen scope or authorize remediation. Inspect the exact batch and provider diagnostics before retrying.
prohibited_recovery_actions: Do not let local AI add paths, browse outside the packet, mutate canonical knowledge, advance accepted baselines, restart/reset hardware, or authorize remediation.
activation_restart_impact: No daemon or scheduler restart; the worker is operator-invoked and uses the existing local Ollama service and SQLite projection.
